item.content:encoded:
Rwanda have advanced to the quarterfinals of the CAVB Women’s African Nations Championship in Kenya after completing the group stage with a perfect record.

The victory capped an impressive run for Rwanda, who won every match without dropping a single set on their way to the quarterfinals.

item.title: RDF, TPDF Medical Teams Treat 1,200 Patients During EAC Civil-Military Week in Tanzania
